arms.name: allocation-control
arms.description: Creates/releases the identical deterministic item records, filter passes, and 12 transient DOM nodes without mounting EnhancedSelect.

arms.name: component-no-probe
arms.description: Runs the same actual EnhancedSelect workload without listener/ResizeObserver instrumentation; the 1k warm-up includes one renderer replacement like the functional lifecycle gate.

arms.name: component-instrumented
arms.description: Runs the identical component workload with counter-only listener/ResizeObserver instrumentation matching the existing lifecycle probe design; the 1k warm-up includes one renderer replacement.

protocol.windowComparison: Four consecutive 25-cycle post-warm-up windows; first and later windows are reported independently.
protocol.snapshots: Raw Chrome DevTools heap snapshots after warm-up and after final cleanup, captured on repeat 1 of each arm and workload. Snapshot object summaries are in the .heapsnapshot profile; inspect retaining paths in DevTools Memory panel.
protocol.heap: Three forced Chromium garbage collections before each reported Runtime.getHeapUsage sample; JavaScript heap is not total browser memory.
protocol.noThresholds: No absolute or percentage heap threshold and no leak classification from heap deltas alone.
protocol.knownProbeOwnershipPath: window.__phase4AttributionProbe.stateById → counter-only record (numeric ID and listener/observer counts); it intentionally persists for the page and never points to component hosts.
attributionSignals: CDP DOM node and listener counts
probe active resource counters and record count
raw heap snapshots for retained-object and root-path inspection
